messages.author: 6e643d837d733481
messages.subject: packrat install problems for RStudio
parts:
I had trouble getting the RStudio gui (1.0.136) to recognize the presence of packrat (both 0.4.8-1 and 0.4.8-13); the check box "Use packrat with this project" would not appear when opening a new project. After much searching and trial and error, I finally realized that I needed to install Rtools and I had to include "devtools::setup_rtools()" in my .Rprofile file. Does anyone else have to do that as well?

I am not that interested in package development at this point. The installation instructions at https://rstudio.github.io/packrat/ were therefore not clear to me, especially the line "You’ll also need to make sure your machine is able to build packages from source." I thought that was for people who like "to live on the bleeding edge". Perhaps there could be RStudio-specific installation instructions?

Many thanks.

messages.author: ab0d2be2ea8dabe8
messages.subject: Re: packrat install problems for RStudio
parts:
Hi Ben,

CRAN only publishes binary packages for the 'current' version of a particular package, so once you attempt to install an older version of a package (as you might do if you've frozen the R package dependencies for a project, and attempt to transfer that project to a separate machine) you'll need to install from sources, which requires build tools.

Packrat could potentially download and store package binaries within a project for re-use, but unfortunately this is not done right now.

Best,
Kevin
